title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a southern-hemisphere preset to the Session 2 app
body:
## Problem
The Session 2 app presets are all at 40 degrees north.

## Context
Students in the southern hemisphere want to see their own seasons.

## Expected outcome
A preset for 35 degrees south on both solstices.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-02/app.html`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Preset shows the opposite seasons
- [ ] Screenshot added to the pull request

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: a truer Moon calendar
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`. The shipped calendar uses mean motion and is several hours off.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add a moonrise calculator using the Moon's declination
body:
## Problem
Session 3 treats the Moon as sitting on the celestial equator.

## Context
Roadmap milestone 2.

## Expected outcome
A lesson and app showing moonrise times at a chosen latitude with the real tilt.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Delay varies from night to night
- [ ] Checkpoint added

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: orbit, terminator, day-length curves and Moon
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows the tilted Earth, the day-length curves and the Moon together; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Loop whose first and last frames match
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
